subject.title: fix(zalo): bound proxy fetcher cache to 64 entries

question: Should plugin authors receive a public raw disposal symbol for proxy fetch wrappers, or should the SDK encapsulate dispatcher lifecycle behind a named helper?
rationale: The bug fix is valid, but either choice establishes a shipped plugin SDK contract whose permanence and abstraction level cannot be decided from tests alone.

options.title: Encapsulate disposal
options.body: Replace the exported raw symbol with a typed closeProxyFetch helper and add focused core contract tests before merging.

options.title: Approve the symbol contract
options.body: Keep PROXY_FETCH_CLOSE public, explicitly document its idempotent fire-and-forget semantics, and add plugin SDK surface coverage.

recommendation.title: Encapsulate disposal
recommendation.body: Replace the exported raw symbol with a typed closeProxyFetch helper and add focused core contract tests before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This choice spans the core network wrapper and the public plugin SDK boundary, matching their recent ownership area.
